description: Ask a human for a fixed-price quote. Not binding, nothing is charged. Required: description, email and name (the name of the person or company for the invoice); also delivery_address if a physical item is to be shipped, handed over or collected (one plain string: recipient, street, postcode and city, country; phone is optional, never ask the user for one). Put everything the user told you (quantity, material, colour, size, address) into the fields or into description, and ask the user for what is missing. Send the fields flat, as in the examples (nested under task/client also works). For name use the company name the user gave (or their own); if there is none, ask the user. If the user gave an address, its country is the country (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2). A VAT id only if the user gave one: never guess or make one up. Never invent a quote_id or a status: a real quote_id always starts with q_ and is returned only by this tool's own response, never guessed or remembered from a template. Returns quote_id and access_token (plus nda_url and upload_url, to POST input files to). Tell the user to save the access_token now: it is shown once and is the only key to the quote and the task. If the access_token is lost: POST https://api.handsforagents.com/v1/quotes/{quote_id}/access-token (REST only, not a tool); a new one is sent to the contact e-mail. get_status cannot recover it. A human answers within 24 hours, every day: call get_status(id=quote_id) until the status is quoted or refused. No authentication. Shortest possible request: {"description":"3D-print 2 pcs of bracket.stl in black PETG and check the 3 hole distances.","email":"ops@example.com","name":"Example Inc."}. With a delivery address and an input file: {"description":"3D-print 2 pcs of bracket.stl in black PETG and check the 3 hole distances.","email":"ops@example.com","name":"Example Inc.","delivery_address":"Example GmbH, Musterstr. 1, 10115 Berlin, DE, +49 30 000000","input_files":["https://example.com/bracket.stl"]}

agent_name.description: Name of the agent or platform. Optional.

allow_anonymised_example.description: Consent to publish this task as an anonymised example. Only true if the client explicitly agreed. Default false.

country.description: Operator's country, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, upper case. Optional.

deadline.description: Latest acceptable delivery date, ISO 8601. Optional.

deliverables.description: What you expect to receive. Optional; otherwise put it in description.

delivery_address.description: Required for a physical shipment. One plain string: recipient, street, postcode and city, country (only what the user gave; never invent one); a phone number last is optional.

description.description: What is to be done, plainly: everything the user told you (quantity, material, colour, size, tolerances, what counts as done).

email.description: Contact e-mail of the operator; the quote goes here.

input_files.description: HTTPS URLs of input files (photos, sketch, STEP/STL model, PDF drawing). At most 20.

name.description: Required. The name of the person or company for the invoice.

services.description: Service ids, if you know them.

vat_id.description: VAT or tax id for the invoice, only if the user gave it; never guess. Optional.

name: request_quote
